post.title: Stop #N/A from wrecking a sheet before you send it on
post.description:
how to replace #N/A in a vlookup when the name isn't in the list
Wrap the lookup in IFERROR and give the miss a label, or two empty quote marks if you want the cell blank. Save this one.
